flags.text: Okay so I approved your proposal, but I had some feedback on it- leading me to two conclusions. #1: the feedback- I like the “still need these” one, but go 21 days first, and then the next time maybe go 40-50 or sum? Or let me pick? Idk, just I know have had the 3Ds project pending for months already and I won’t want it always popping up. I like the rest. #2, it’s not as simple as approve / deny, although I like having a yes/no act on it button. So let’s leave the approve / deny, but add a space for feedback? So just a space where I say exactly what I like or don’t and approve you to act, or give you feedback on why I don’t like what you did so you can do it differently the next try?

Claude OS (kiosk)
You're right, the artifact frame is the problem. The fix:
• Host it on GitHub Pages and add it to the iPhone Home Screen as a web app. That opens fullscreen with no Safari bars at all.
• Turn on Guided Access to lock the phone to it, and set Auto-Lock to Never.
• Live control: the page checks a small settings file in the repo every 30 seconds or so. You tell me "alarm at 6:30" or "show something funi from any chat, I edit the file, and the phone updates within a minute or two, no reloading. One catch:
¡OS needs a single tap after launch before it'll play sound.
Let’s do this sooner than later, just not quite priority

These descriptions take up half this flag’s space, and the rest is empty cause little icons take that entire space, even through they’re little. Want to adjust so the space is better used? Let the text go all the way to the right and make those icons sit above maybe?

flags.text: All of these little tags I can add, I’d prefer a drop down of maybe a scrolling list like you have down below. Also I wouldn’t mind more color on this whole website instead of like 2 total. Some more colors wouldn’t go wrong fs.

Maybe make me another flag hub widget that is large on scriptable, and allows me to see previews of the flags. Basically had the same info as the medium one, but that info is consolidated to the top and the other 3/4 of the bigger space can be a list of the flags, sorted by priority and then secondly more recent first. Not the whole blurb, but like the first line of them? Make sense?
flags.resolution: Added scriptable/flag-hub-large-widget.js: counts up top, then your top 10 flags (priority first, newest next).

flags.text: Another idea, some flags aren’t current and could be resolved, or become so old it’s worth reviewing if they should stick around. Maybe make a needs review mechanism or sum for flags to come back around so I can resolve them and this never become too massively cluttered?

A lot of the flags here are ones requiring action from me not you, maybe we should add seperate colored flags for me? Not anything that show on the different web apps, but instead only shows within this app- the for claude flags can be an orange like now, and for me flags are teal seafoam green. Then you don’t have to sift through a ton of flags that are really just reminders for me. I can just add them here directly, you don’t need to add a way to input teal flags on any apps.
The Apple icon of this repo won’t render correctly, if I add it to the home screen it just shows a white background with black text over it.
